chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi tests Gu Suizhou's resilience through a high-pressure password decryption task, which Gu Suizhou fails, leading to a self-harming attempt to break his handcuffs. Shen Feizhi treats his injuries, revealing a shared history of self-destructive tendencies. Gu Suizhou continues to aggressively pursue a closer relationship with Shen Feizhi, who remains emotionally distant and physically repulsed by intimacy. Shen Feizhi returns to his work at W.N., investigating the mysterious fire caused by Professor Gu and Professor Lin, while also discovering that his associate, Leapton, has been secretly investigating his personal life.
